settings.graphics.expand_collision.enabl.text: Pushes newly expanded items away from nearby content to reduce overlap.

settings.graphics.expand_collision.strat.text: Chooses how the first items are picked when overlap resolution begins.

settings.graphics.expand_collision.anima.text: Animates the repositioning pass so the settled layout stays readable.

settings.graphics.expand_collision.scope.text: Limits which nearby items can move when the expanded area needs room.

settings.graphics.expand_collision.gap_p.text: Sets the target spacing kept between the expanded area and moved items.

settings.graphics.expand_collision.radiu.text: Controls whether overlap checks stay local or search across the full canvas.

settings.graphics.expand_collision.local.text: Sets how far the local search reaches when reach mode stays nearby.

settings.graph_theme.use_selected.text: Set this theme as the active graph theme

settings.workflow.environment.applicatio.text: Sets the app-wide Python executable used when the current workflow has no override.

settings.workflow.environment.browse_app.text: Choose the app-wide default Python executable from this PC.

settings.workflow.environment.prepare_ma.text: Creates or repairs COREX's app-managed venv, installs the packaged COREX runtime with [all] dependencies through pip, verifies it, and fills the application default executable.

settings.workflow.environment.clear_appl.text: Clears only the app-wide default. A workflow override remains active when set.

settings.workflow.environment.workflow_p.text: Sets the project-owned Python executable that overrides the application default for the whole workflow.

settings.workflow.environment.browse_wor.text: Choose this workflow's overriding Python executable from this PC.

settings.workflow.environment.inherit_ap.text: Clears only the workflow override so the next run inherits the application default, or uses built-in execution when both are blank.

settings.workflow.environment.managed_ru.text: Shows whether COREX's app-managed workflow runtime exists and where its python.exe will be created.

settings.workflow.environment.working_di.text: Saved with the workflow settings, but workflow execution does not enforce this directory yet.
